主要内容: On January 25, 2016, Novavax, Inc. announced preliminary financial results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2015. The company expects to report approximately $231 million in cash and cash equivalents and marketable securities as of December 31, 2015. This amount is preliminary and has not been audited, with potential changes upon completion of the audit. The information provided is part of a Form 8-K filing and is not deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
